capabilities: sort task lists automatically by status
keep subtasks attached to their parent task
exclude individual notes from automatic sorting
configure the typing delay before sorting
toggle automatic sorting per note or vault-wide
extras: The manifest carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The author names two other plugins, Notemoji and Cloudboard, but only as recommendations, not as dependencies.
problem: Obsidian task lists keep tasks in the order they were written, so completed items clutter the list and open tasks get buried.
summary: Task list sorter that automatically moves completed tasks to the bottom of each Markdown task list while keeping subtasks attached to their parents.
